title: Hot Oatmeal with Blueberries and Panela
excerpt: Comforting hot oatmeal sweetened with grated panela and served with juicy fresh blueberries. A traditional Colombian breakfast, ideal for starting the morning with warmth.
imageAlt: Bowl of creamy hot oatmeal with dissolved panela, topped with fresh blueberries, a cinnamon stick and walnuts.
steps: In a medium pot, combine the water, milk, cinnamon stick and grated panela. Heat over medium heat until the panela dissolves. We use half the usual sweetener because Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar.
Add the rolled oats along with the pinch of salt and stir well with a wooden spoon.
Cook over medium-low heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring constantly to keep it from sticking and to get a creamy texture.
Add half of the blueberries one minute before turning off the heat so they warm up and gently release their juice.
Serve the oatmeal piping hot in bowls, remove the cinnamon and top with the remaining Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the mountains of Guasca, and the chopped walnuts.
tips: Store the blueberries in the refrigerator in their original packaging, unwashed, to preserve their freshness, and wash them only right before eating.
If you prefer an even creamier texture, you can soak the oats in the liquid the night before cooking them.
This recipe uses half the usual sweetener: Fresh Pick blueberries have more natural sugar, so we cut it back. Taste it and, if you prefer it sweeter, add a little more.
